sections_in_order: Coverage Determinations (table by line of business)
criteria_location: 'Clinical Indications for None-Medicare Members' (main ALL list of 6 numbered items) plus a second 'ALSO' list of diagnoses, then separate Exclusions section and grading tables. Pages 1-2 of 6.
procedures_covered: Total and partial knee arthroplasty treated as one set of criteria (27437-27447)

logic.top_level: pathways (two: the ALL-of-6 degenerative joint disease path; the ALSO-any-of-7 diagnoses path)

k_of_n.quote: Radiographic or arthroscopic evidence of moderate to severe osteoarthritis as evidenced by 1 or more of the following
a trial of 1 or more of the following medications: NSAIDs (oral or topical), Acetaminophen, Intra-articular injection of corticosteroids
for ANY of the following diagnoses

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Separate 'Exclusions' section: a not-medically-necessary list (infection, unstable angina, anything interfering with rehabilitation, no caregiver, non-ambulatory). BMI and A1c are written as criteria 5 and 6 inside the ALL list, with conditional branches.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: No revision or repeat criteria even though revision codes are in the table.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: BMI < 40: if BMI is > 40, optimization efforts must include ALL the following
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: BMI exactly 40 is covered by neither '< 40' nor '> 40'. Then 'BMI > 40 is a relative contraindication' and a medical director reviews 'case-by-case', so criterion 5 is simultaneously a hard requirement and a soft one.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: If optimization attempts are unsuccessful, the surgeon and patient may proceed if there is documentation of understanding of the risks through shared decision making
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Sits inside the 'ALL the following' optimization list as a third bullet, but it is an alternative fallback ('If ... unsuccessful'), not a further requirement.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: If diabetic the HbA1c < 7.5 (with the presence of heart disease, no specific A1c requirement), if A1C >7.5 the following must be documented
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: A1c exactly 7.5 uncovered. The heart-disease clause waives the threshold, but 'heart disease' is undefined. Only requirement for A1c > 7.5 is 'active medical management pre and post operatively', which a pre-op chart cannot show post-operatively.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Treatment is needed because of functional disabling pain of at least 3 months duration
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Criterion 1 (pain 3 months) and criterion 3 (3 months conservative treatment) overlap in time; unclear if the same 3 months can satisfy both.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: a trial of at least 3 Physical Therapy sessions in the last 12 months ... OR documentation that Physical Therapy is not clinically appropriate due to severe pain, severe functional limitations OR severe (end-stage) osteoarthritis
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: The exemption OR list is itself an OR inside an OR; the 'documentation that includes flexibility/muscle strengthening exercises and reasonable restriction of activities' attaches to the PT branch only by reading.

typo in heading; extraction of section by heading text will miss

extraction_hazards: Bullets render as private-use glyphs in text (squares); sub-bullets lose nesting depth.
Numbered criteria 1-6 hang their continuation lines at column 0, so wrapped lines look like new paragraphs.
Two short grading tables follow the criteria and are separate from them.
Header says 'NCP 114 (was NCP 14 until 8/4/26)' while Effective is 2/4/2026 and Last Reviewed 6/24/26: dates and numbering are internally odd (the renumbering date follows the review date).
Reference list cites LCD L36577 and L36007 while coverage table cites L36575: LCD number inconsistency.
interesting_structures: Quantified optimization pathway for BMI and A1c that converts a hard threshold into a documented-effort alternative (soft gate with medical director review).
PT requirement of 3 sessions in 12 months with a clinical-inappropriateness exemption.
Partial and total arthroplasty share one criteria set; no separate UKA geometry (no ACL, ROM, deformity tests).
Line-of-business table at the top routes Medicare to an LCD and excludes Medicaid.

fit_to_tree.scale: 1 = clean, 5 = needs new constructs or human judgment
fit_to_tree.why: Top-level ALL of 6 with k-of-n leaves maps well, but BMI/A1c are conditional with fallbacks and medical-director discretion, PT has a clinical exemption, and the exclusions need a NOT over social facts.
